original_snippet: LDR R2,[R0]; MOV LR,PC; LDR PC,[R2]  ; array vtable slot 0 (0x7fe7e8): any element HasDataToSend(a3)? -> WriteBit(1) + elements; else WriteBit(0)
explanation: The presence gate of the original is the array's own HasDataToSend (0x7fe7e8), which returns true when ANY element has data for the peer and false when the count is 0. The port tests only members_[0]. A change in a later member (not slot 0) is not sent, and with memberCount_ 0 the port reads members_[0] and can write presence bit 1 where the original writes 0. The port's generic template NetStructArray::HasDataToSend (net_struct_array.hpp) already has the any-element semantics; CMatching does not use it.
